subtitle: Bilingual satellite views and planting-status analysis for Najd farms in Dhofar

home.title: See desert farms from space
home.intro: This platform shows satellite images of Najd farms in Dhofar and helps track planting status after sowing. Vegetation and moisture indices highlight fields that established well versus sparse, irrigation-stressed, or salinity-suspect ones. The aim is clear seasonal monitoring for farmers and researchers in Arabic and English.
home.whyBody: Irrigated pivots and blocks in Najd are large enough for 10 m pixels. Optical VNIR + SWIR supports vegetation, moisture, and salinity-proxy indices. Inland Najd is hyper-arid, so clear scenes are common most months.
home.seasonBody: Typical sowing is early–mid November; harvest starts in early April. Check establishment Dec–Jan, peak vigor Feb–Mar, post-harvest Apr–May, and off-season stress Jun–Oct.
home.previewNote: Live Sentinel-2 NDVI/NDMI monitoring is on the Analysis and Map pages. Gallery still shows browse previews.

map.title: Farm corridor map
map.blurb: Working AOI for active farms (Thumrait–Shisr–Hanfit–Saih Al-Khairat). Al-Mazyunah lies west of the core corridor.
map.liveBlurb: 500 m cells from the latest clear Sentinel-2 scene. Water and vigor flags are relative to vegetated peers — not lab diagnoses.

gallery.title: Satellite scenes
gallery.blurb: Browse true-color and NDVI previews from Sentinel-2 (and one Landsat-8 scene). Filter by tile, season, and product type.

analysis.title: Planting-status analysis
analysis.blurb: Indices and field classes for arid irrigated wheat. Thresholds should be calibrated with local field data.
analysis.ndviDesc: Green biomass, phenology, crop vs bare, failed plantings (flat/low curve).
analysis.saviDesc: Sparse canopy over bright desert soil; reduces soil noise versus NDVI.
analysis.ndmiDesc: Canopy water / irrigation stress through the season.
analysis.establishedDesc: NDVI rises by Dec–Jan and peaks Feb–Mar above bare/neighbor thresholds.
analysis.sparseDesc: Weak or delayed green-up; high within-field NDVI variance.
analysis.irrigationDesc: NDVI OK early, NDMI drops mid-season; often warmer than peers.
analysis.salinityDesc: Chronically low peak NDVI; high salinity proxies on fallow scenes — needs field EC.
analysis.abandonedDesc: Persistent bare signature across winter while neighbors green.
analysis.compareBody: March peak-wheat scenes show bright NDVI on active pivots. Late-summer scenes return to bare desert reflectance — useful for abandoned vs cropped contrast.

issues.d: Late sowing after early Nov cuts yield; low/late Dec–Jan NDVI rise.
Mid-season NDMI drop; early senescence; warmer Landsat LST vs neighbors.
Reduced peak NDVI and bare-soil salinity indices — calibrate with EC samples.
Bare all winter while adjacent fields green.
Circular NDVI rings or pie wedges of low vigor.
Compressed NDVI season; premature drop Mar–Apr.

about.title: Method & data
about.blurb: Groundwork from the Najd satellite investigation support report.
about.aoiBody: Practical farm-corridor bbox ≈ [53.4, 17.5, 54.3, 18.5], center ~18.0°N, 53.8°E. Broader Najd literature bbox is larger (hydro-geographic).
about.sensorsBody: Primary: Sentinel-2 L2A tiles 39QZV, 39QYA, 39QZA, 39QYV, 39QXV (+ adjacent). Backup: Landsat 8/9 path 160 rows 047–048.
workflow: Digitize pivot/block boundaries on true-color or basemap.
Extract per-field NDVI / SAVI / NDMI time series.
Validate with ground photos, farmer reports, and EC samples.
about.limitBody: This demo shows browse preview PNGs and educational analysis views. It does not stream live COGs or compute indices on the fly yet.

footer: Najd Planting Monitor · browse imagery MVP · not a substitute for field survey

live.liveBlurb: Computed NDVI and NDMI from Sentinel-2 L2A COG bands over the farm window. Weekly re-run ready.
live.timeseriesBlurb: Mean NDVI / NDMI and attention counts for clear scenes in the monitor window.
live.error: Could not load live monitor data.
live.note: Alerts are relative early-intervention flags among vegetated cells, not definitive diagnoses.
live.tip_bare: Little or no green canopy in this cell for the acquisition date.
live.tip_healthy: Vegetation indices look stable versus nearby vegetated cells.
live.tip_water_attention: Canopy moisture (NDMI) is low versus nearby vegetated areas — verify irrigation soon.
live.tip_vigor_attention: Greening (NDVI) is weak versus peers. May need fertilizer or other management — confirm in the field (satellite cannot diagnose fertilizer alone).
live.tip_unclear: Signal is ambiguous for this cell — review imagery and field conditions.
